evidence: The report attributes these related preinstalled firmware packages to the same projector ecosystem: com.htc.eventuploadservice sends device identifiers to event-api.aodintech.com without consent, and com.htc.expandsdk injects ads using remote configuration and system overlays. The app schema uses MALWARE_C2 as its coarse category for malware/spyware apps. Source analysis through 2026-06-18: https://github.com/Kavan00/Android-Projector-C2-Malware. Independent package/endpoint mapping: https://zanestjohn.com/blog/reing-with-claude-code.
